{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders, excluding QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                               (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
                               (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
